description: Get or resume an ad creation job by jobId. Returns the full result and original stage progress by default. Pass compact:true for an ads summary with created/failed/total counts and progress measured in ads. Includes the last 20 progress.operations (operations:"full" returns all retained operations). After ads_create returns still_running, poll until complete is true; compact running jobs include a nextStep hint.

compact.description: Opt in to a compact ads summary. Default false preserves the full result and original stage progress.

operations.description: Use recent for the last 20 operations or full for the complete operation log.

name: ads_get_job
title: Get Job Status
